annotation.title_clean: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.title_en: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pandemic Preparedness Partnership (report to the UK G7 Presidency)
annotation.summary_en: Independent report by the Pandemic Preparedness Partnership to the UK G7 Presidency proposing a 100 Days Mission to make diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of a pandemic threat. It draws on COVID-19 lessons and gives recommendations on R&D, surveillance, manufacturing, financing and global rules. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aim to deploy safe, effective diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines within 100 days of a WHO PHEIC declaration.
Invest in R&D targeting critical viral families and innovative, modular vaccine manufacturing.
Establish agreed 'rules of the road' for data sharing, regulatory approvals and procurement during a pandemic.
Secure pre-arranged financing so DTVs reach low-income countries equitably.
Strengthen global surveillance and an international clinical trials network.
